protocol.geographic_separation_note: The test scene is Indian; the reference datasets this project has real evidence from (SEN2NEON: North America; OpenSR-Test: Spain/SPOT) are geographically disjoint from it. This establishes geographic separation of the EVIDENCE datasets, not of the deployed model's unknown training set (see training_domain_known).
protocol.hr_reference_note: No Indian HR reference (Cartosat, Resourcesat, AVIRIS-NG or otherwise) has been obtained or validated by this project (docs/TRACEABILITY.md Sec 9). Reference-based accuracy (PSNR/SSIM/RMSE/SAM/ERGAS) is therefore not computed for this scene -- not omitted by oversight, structurally unavailable. Substituting a non-Indian HR reference here would misrepresent it as Indian-reference evidence, which Requirements 142 explicitly forbids.
protocol.land_cover_note: not established -- no land-cover label exists for this scene (see frame.data.adapters.india_holdout)
protocol.stability_method: TTA stability -- reconstruction-variation diagnostic (uncalibrated; see docs/RELIABILITY.md)
protocol.training_domain: The deployed SEN2SR-Lite/Mamba weights are third-party (tacofoundation/sen2sr); their original training data and geography are not documented in the artifact manifest FRAME inspected (docs/REGISTRY.md Sec 1) and are not established here. FRAME's own training work (docs/TRAINING.md) never touched these weights -- it trained a separate, small synthetic-data smoke model only. Naming a training domain for the model actually serving /sr/run would be a fabricated claim.

stability_definition: Mean per-pixel standard deviation across the TTA ensemble, averaged over bands. A relative model-stability proxy, not a calibrated confidence value.
